─────────────────────────────
Tier 1: Single subscription owns + consumes (no sharing)
Tier 2 (Preview): Provider shares with up to ~100 consumers, same region + AZ
Tier 3 (Preview): Provider can forcibly disassociate consumer VMs
(needs consumer credential model — G-14, undesigned)
